_comment: Upstream skills Site Roast reuses instead of rewriting. `npm run sync` copies each `path` into .claude/skills/<name>/ and pins the resolved commit in skills.lock.json. Set `ref` to a tag/sha to freeze one; default tracks the branch head.

skills.name: ai-writing-detector
skills.why: Deterministic AI-writing scanner (scripts/detect.js) - scores page copy, context=marketing.

skills.name: avoid-ai-writing
skills.why: Canonical rulebook the detector defers to (false-positive cautions, context exceptions).

skills.name: humanizer
skills.why: Wikipedia 'Signs of AI writing' catalogue - model-judged second opinion on copy tells.

skills.name: avoid-ai-design
skills.why: AI design-tells catalogue (1st + 2nd order) and zero-dep scanner scripts/detect.mjs for code-certain tells.

skills.name: hallmark
skills.why: 57 slop-test gates - used as a checklist against screenshots.

skills.name: impeccable
skills.why: audit / critique modes: hierarchy, typography, spacing, colour, motion, UX copy, a11y.

skills.name: web-design-guidelines
skills.why: Vercel Web Interface Guidelines compliance review (fetches the live guideline list).

skills.name: frontend-design
skills.why: Anthropic's own list of distributional-default aesthetics - the clusters to flag.

skills.name: product-marketing
skills.why: Foundation: infer product, audience, positioning before judging the pitch.

skills.name: cro
skills.why: Page CRO framework: value prop clarity, CTA, objections, social proof, friction.

skills.name: copywriting
skills.why: Does the copy sell the value or just describe features?

skills.name: copy-editing
skills.why: Line-level clarity, jargon, scannability sweeps.

skills.name: marketing-psychology
skills.why: Persuasion principles used/missed (anchoring, proof, loss aversion...).

skills.name: seo-audit
skills.why: On-page SEO basics: titles, meta, headings, indexability.

skills.name: ai-seo
skills.why: Is the site legible to LLM answer engines (citability, structure, llms.txt)?

skills.name: design-taste-frontend
skills.why: Taste Skill: anti-slop design standards (variance/motion/density dials, pre-flight checklist). Used as the taste bar for the visual lens.

skills.name: redesign-existing-projects
skills.why: Taste Skill's audit checklist for existing sites: generic AI patterns in type, colour, layout, states. Maps 1:1 to roast findings.

skills.name: web-quality-audit
skills.why: Evidence-led Lighthouse-style audit (perf, a11y, SEO, best practices, agentic browsing); ships scripts/analyze.sh HTML checker.

skills.name: accessibility
skills.why: WCAG 2.2 checks: contrast, keyboard, landmarks, alt text, forms.

skills.name: performance
skills.why: Load-time budget and the usual culprits (hero media, render-blocking, fonts).

skills.name: core-web-vitals
skills.why: How to read LCP / CLS / INP numbers from the Lighthouse detector.

skills.name: pre-launch-audit
skills.why: Technical SEO, AI-crawler access (robots/llms.txt), security headers, stack detection. Its 'interpret, don't enumerate' rules match the roast voice.
